analysis_kind: deterministic representation cost scaling from frozen C4 code, not a qualification result
candidate_family: asinh endpoint-pair bilinear log(K_DAR/K_MFP) with fixed signed pressure-head decade anchors

scaling.runtime_lookup_per_face: O(1) bilinear interpolation after shared immutable preparation
scaling.offline_cell_generation: each cell invokes the direct steady-Darcian oracle except exact special cases; oracle cost itself is not constant with hydraulic difficulty

architecture_interpretation: The table is immutable shared parameter/geometry data and therefore does not add per-column persistent state.
Quadratic class storage can still become material in MultiSWAP when many hydraulic-material and geometry classes are admitted.
Offline oracle generation cost is not production timestep cost, but excessive preparation cost or class cardinality can make template creation operationally unattractive.
No memory acceptance threshold is introduced here. C4 must first establish error convergence and later combine it with observed production catalog/geometry class cardinality.
If error convergence is slow relative to this quadratic growth, brute-force global density escalation should be stopped rather than justified by shared-memory ownership alone.
